name: Educational Assistance for Degree Course
benefit: - Financial assistance of ₹20,000/- per year for undergraduate students.
_eligibility_text: 1. The children's parents or guardians should be registered under the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The student must be enrolled in a degree course (1st, 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year). 1. The benefit applies to a maximum of two children and the wife of a registered male worker.
